units.source_text: 無論是教室還是宿舍，感覺簡直就是瀰漫著性慾扭曲的垃圾堆，

en.t: Whether it was the classroom or the dormitory, they felt like garbage heaps saturated with twisted sexual desire,

units.source_text: 我那近乎完美的搞笑本領，在此根本派不上用場。

en.t: My almost perfect gift for clowning around was of absolutely no use there.

units.source_text: 父親在議會休會時，每個月只在別墅住一兩週。

en.t: When parliament was not in session, Father stayed at the villa for only one or two weeks each month.

units.source_text: 所以，父親不在時，寬敞的別墅裡，只剩下管家老夫婦和我三個人。

en.t: So when Father was away, only three people remained in the spacious villa: the old caretaker couple and me.

units.source_text: 我常常逃課，又沒有心思遊逛東京（最終連明治神宮、楠木正成的銅像、泉嶽寺的四十七烈士墓都沒去過），

en.t: I often skipped school, yet had no inclination to go sightseeing around Tokyo; in the end, I never even visited Meiji Shrine, the bronze statue of Kusunoki Masashige, or the graves of the forty-seven ronin at Sengakuji,

units.source_text: 整天窩在家裡看書畫畫。

en.t: I spent all day shut up at home, reading books and drawing pictures.
